# Trimx — entry point for GitHub Copilot

A lightweight image editor for Windows 11 (C# / .NET 10 / WPF / SkiaSharp).

Before working, read these files from the shared context in `.ai/`. Do not add content to this file; update `.ai/` instead.

- `.ai/project.md` — overview, status, build, release
- `.ai/architecture.md` — layering and design rules
- `.ai/conventions.md` — coding conventions and working rules
- `.ai/pitfalls.md` — easy-to-break areas
- `.ai/implementation-notes.md` — per-feature implementation details (only when touching that feature)

The primary source for requirements is `docs/plan.md` (Japanese). Respond to the maintainer in Japanese, confirm the build with `dotnet build Trimx.slnx` after changes, and do not add features that are not in plan.md.
